g.title: Long shot. The docks at night, in the rain. Alice, centre, arms crossed, looking at Bob; Bob, centre. Caption: Midnight. The docks. Alice: You said you would be here at ten. Bob, whispering: I was.
Long shot. The docks at dawn, in fog. Alice, centre, arms crossed, looking at Bob; Bob, centre. Caption: Six hours later.
Long shot. The docks by day. Alice, centre, arms crossed, looking at Bob; Bob, centre. Editor's note: It never rains at noon.
Long shot. The docks at dusk, in the snow. Alice, centre, arms crossed, looking at Bob; Bob, centre. Caption: December.
